spec_match.rationale: Covers the change's two other named triggers with the correct mechanism explanation: a secondary-button pair produces no click, and a past-slop drag suppresses the click — so the click model ignores both while the pair model dismisses. These proved to be the reliable model discriminators on real engines.

interactive.rationale: Two live stages (right-click area, selectable text) against a real popover; per-gesture verdicts computed from trusted event data including selection length and movement distance.

blurb_alignment.rationale: Index blurb promises per-gesture verdicts for both triggers; delivered.

edge_cases.rationale: Plain taps labelled correct-in-both-models; gestures with the popover closed non-diagnostic; contextmenu logged so users see the menu event alongside the popover's fate; opening-button presses excluded from gesture tracking.

references.rationale: Feature index cites https://chromestatus.com/feature/6209615938322432; the banner records the measured fact that pre-145 builds ignore the flag.

conformance.rationale: Foundations covered by the suite's popover-machinery and untrusted-immunity assertions; trusted-gesture outcomes are demo-measured.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Headless Chromium 141 via trusted CDP mouse input: right press-release outside → popover DISMISSED, verdict correctly names the pair-model signature; primary drag-select across the sentence (360px, 53 characters selected) → popover DISMISSED, legacy verdict with measured distance and selection. Both re-run with --enable-blink-features=LightDismissFromClick: identical outcomes, confirming pre-145 builds ignore the flag (now stated in the banner). Zero console errors; 0px overflow both classes; screenshots read.

design_system.rationale: Stages on paper, selectable region dashed ivory, verdict rose/emerald; CSS variables only.

accessibility.rationale: Popover state mirrored in role=status; verdict role=status aria-live; log role=log with labelling heading; the selectable region is plain text (no interaction traps); touch long-press alternative documented.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: Single-column stages; popover max-width 78vw; 0px overflow at 360×740 DPR3 and 1280×2000; long-press documented as the touch equivalent for stage 1.

openQuestions.title: Capture the click-model outcomes on Chrome 145+
openQuestions.detail: With LightDismissFromClick actually implemented (145+), both gestures should leave the popover open and the verdicts should flip to the modern branch — capture that run to complete the evidence pair.

guidanceConsulted.query: popover light dismiss outside click touch scroll gesture
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Native popover semantics; observe via toggle.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: All dismissal behavior native; verdicts from observation only.

guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Announce gesture outcomes as text, not visual state alone.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Verdicts and log are live regions with full textual detail (distance, selection count, event names).

summary: Verified headlessly with trusted CDP input (no chrome-devtools-mcp in this cloud session): both discriminating gestures measured for real on the pair-model engine — right click and drag-select each dismissed the popover with correct legacy verdicts — and the flagged re-run's identical results exposed that pre-145 builds silently ignore the flag, now recorded on the page.
